column1: # MCP servers, one row per server, consumed by _scripts/mcp-servers and checked
# by agents/_mcp-servers-rules.sh. This is the one declaration: the tracked Zed
# and OpenCode files are rendered from it and hold nothing else, and Claude
# Code and Codex, whose configuration is machine-local, receive it through
# Columns: name, transport, target, environment, agents
# transport is "remote" (target is an https URL) or "local" (target is the
# command line that starts a stdio server). environment is "-" or
# space-separated KEY=value pairs for a local server; no value here is ever a
# credential. agents is a comma-separated subset of claude, codex, opencode
# Claude Code is absent from the PostHog row because its PostHog plugin brings
# the same server. Codex is absent from it because `codex mcp add` opens a
# browser sign-in for that server and waits, which an installer cannot do; the
# checklist names the command to run by hand. Argent is absent altogether: OpenCode 1 honours its timeout
# only in a deprecated form this catalog does not render (opencode/README.md).
